text:
Alex: Planning a targeted deploy tonight in the 22:30 UTC change window. Touches: api header routing, runtime kernel selection, and console schema toggle. Need cross-team coordination (api/runtime/router/console). Rollback gates: error rate > 0.7% OR p99 tail increase > 1s for 3m.

Priya: Copy. I'll hold any console schema migrations until after router is green. Which runtime artifact are we using?

Alex: We'll pin runtime -> rtx-2.3.2-alphaquant for canary; rollback to rtx-2.2.10 if regressions. Router will use header-based split: X-RD-Stage with values `kern-v2` vs `kern-v1`. Deploy order: wave1=api+runtime, wave2=router, wave3=console toggle.

Jorge: I'll run router flip. Flag name? and canary percentages?

Alex: Flag `hdr-route-split`, canaries start at 3% (we want a bit more signal tonight). Wave schedule: wave1 22:30 (3%), wave2 22:40 (3%), wave3 22:50 (3%). @deploy-bot please schedule.

deploy-bot: Scheduling waves:
- wave1: api, runtime @ 22:30 UTC (3%)
- wave2: router @ 22:40 UTC (3%)
- wave3: console @ 22:50 UTC (3%)
Commands:
```
/deploy create --service api --image api:release-2026-03-22 --wave 1
/deploy create --service runtime --image runtime:rtx-2.3.2-alphaquant --wave 1
```

Maya: Ops note: we'll have ops on standby, dashboards preloaded. Also add kernel artifact checksum to runbook.

Priya: Metric rename FYI: `api.request.router_version` -> `api.request.route_variant`. I'll push a dashboard patch before full rollout.

Jorge: Router split config for staging test:
```
route_split:
  header: X-RD-Stage
  variants:
    kern-v1: 97
    kern-v2: 3
```

Alex: Draft release notes: kernel selection tuning (rtx-2.3.2-alphaquant), header-based routing for gradual kernel rollout, console schema v5 behind toggle. Rollback plan: revert header split + runtime unpin.

Maya: Added explicit rollback commands to runbook and a quick checklist for oncall.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks:
- artifacts present and checksums match
- service dependency graph OK (api -> runtime)
- capacity check: dedicated GPU pools available
Preflight: PASS.

deploy-bot: Canary wave1 started at 22:30 UTC 700 id=wave-4781, target 3% traffic.

deploy-bot: Wave1 results (22:36 UTC): api 3% traffic, errors 0.01%, p99 +0.02ms -> PASS.

deploy-bot: Wave2 started at 22:40 UTC 700 router flag toggled for 3% traffic.

deploy-bot: Wave2 results (22:46 UTC): router splitting healthy, no 5xx increase -> PASS.

deploy-bot: Wave3 started at 22:50 UTC 700 console toggle enabled for 3% of users.

deploy-bot: Wave3 results (22:56 UTC): console migrations fine on canary, no errors. Full rollout scheduled at 23:05 UTC.

Priya: Will hold the console PR merge until we confirm full rollout metrics after 15m.

Jorge: If any gating metric breaches during full rollout we pause and run: `/deploy rollback --service runtime --image runtime:rtx-2.2.10` and `/router revert --flag hdr-route-split --to kern-v1`.

Maya: Ops will monitor for 30m post-rollout. If we see increased latencies we'll open incident channel and execute rollback.

Alex: Release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/1437. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Full rollout started at 23:05 UTC. Monitoring windows: 30m.
